newsitem.title: UK: Ex-LCE board members elected to LIFFE board.
newsitem.headline: Ex-LCE board members elected to LIFFE board.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) has elected four new board members from among the former board of the London Commodity Exchange (LCE).

The exchanges merged under LIFFE on Monday. New LIFFE board members are Bernd Graap of Waren Handelsgesellsschaft Corinth MbH, Michael Metcalfe of E D & F Man Group, Michael Overlander of Sucden UK Ltd and Anthony Ward of Phibro Futures Ltd. The LIFFE board also decided to name SBC Warburg global head of exchange-traded derivatives Mark Enyon to chair a new commodities committee. He was already a member of the LIFFE board which now numbers 25. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
